items.text: Once upon a time. <break time="0.8s" /> There was a mother goat. <break time="0.8s" /> She had seven young goats. <break time="0.8s" /> And loved them all. <break time="0.8s" /> One day. <break time="0.8s" /> She went into the forest. <break time="0.8s" /> For food. <break time="0.8s" /> Do not open the door. <break time="0.8s" /> For the wolf. <break time="0.8s" /> She said. <break time="0.8s" /> He has a rough voice. <break time="0.8s" /> And black feet. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon there was a knock. <break time="0.8s" /> At the door. <break time="0.8s" /> Open the door, children. <break time="0.8s" /> Your mother is here. <break time="0.8s" /> Your voice is rough. <break time="0.8s" /> You are the wolf. <break time="0.8s" /> They cried.

Once upon a time, there was a mother goat. <break time="0.8s" /> She had seven young goats and loved them all. <break time="0.8s" /> One day, she went into the forest for food. <break time="0.8s" /> Do not open the door for the wolf, she said. <break time="0.8s" /> He has a rough voice and black feet. <break time="0.8s" /> Soon there was a knock at the door. <break time="0.8s" /> Open the door, children, Your mother is here. <break time="0.8s" /> Your voice is rough, You are the wolf, they cried.

옛날 옛적에. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마 염소 한 마리가 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마에게는 아기 염소 일곱 마리가 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 아기들을 모두 사랑했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 어느 날. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마는 숲속으로 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 먹을 것을 구하러. <break time="0.8s" /> 문을 열어 주면 안 된다. <break time="0.8s" /> 늑대에게는. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 늑대는 목소리가 거칠단다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 발이 까맣단다. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 똑똑 소리가 났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 문에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 얘들아, 문 열어라. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마가 왔단다. <break time="0.8s" /> 목소리가 거칠어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 당신은 늑대예요. <break time="0.8s" /> 아기 염소들이 외쳤다.

The wolf went away. <break time="0.8s" /> And bought some chalk. <break time="0.8s" /> He ate it. <break time="0.8s" /> And his voice became soft. <break time="0.8s" /> He came back. <break time="0.8s" /> But he put his black paw. <break time="0.8s" /> On the window. <break time="0.8s" /> Our mother. <break time="0.8s" /> Does not have black feet. <break time="0.8s" /> They said. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the wolf went to the baker. <break time="0.8s" /> The baker put soft dough. <break time="0.8s" /> On his feet. <break time="0.8s" /> Next he went to the miller. <break time="0.8s" /> For white flour. <break time="0.8s" /> The miller was afraid. <break time="0.8s" /> So he put flour. <break time="0.8s" /> On the wolfs feet.

The wolf went away and bought some chalk. <break time="0.8s" /> He ate it, and his voice became soft. <break time="0.8s" /> He came back, but he put his black paw on the window. <break time="0.8s" /> Our mother does not have black feet, they said. <break time="0.8s" /> Then the wolf went to the baker. <break time="0.8s" /> The baker put soft dough on his feet. <break time="0.8s" /> Next, he went to the miller for white flour. <break time="0.8s" /> The miller was afraid, so he put flour on the wolfs feet.

늑대는 가 버렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 분필을 조금 샀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 늑대는 분필을 먹었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 목소리가 부드러워졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 늑대는 다시 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 까만 발을 올려놓았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 창문에. <break time="0.8s" /> 우리 엄마는. <break time="0.8s" /> 발이 까맣지 않아요. <break time="0.8s" /> 아기 염소들이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그러자 늑대는 빵집 주인에게 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 빵집 주인은 말랑한 반죽을 발라 주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 늑대의 발에. <break time="0.8s" /> 다음으로 늑대는 방앗간 주인에게 갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하얀 밀가루를 얻으러. <break time="0.8s" /> 방앗간 주인은 겁이 났다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 밀가루를 뿌려 주었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 늑대의 발에.

The wolf came back. <break time="0.8s" /> For the third time. <break time="0.8s" /> Show us your paw first. <break time="0.8s" /> The little goats said. <break time="0.8s" /> The paw was white. <break time="0.8s" /> So they opened the door. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh no it was the wolf. <break time="0.8s" /> They hid under the table. <break time="0.8s" /> In the bed. <break time="0.8s" /> And in the oven. <break time="0.8s" /> The wolf found six goats. <break time="0.8s" /> And swallowed them whole. <break time="0.8s" /> But he did not find the youngest. <break time="0.8s" /> In the big clock. <break time="0.8s" /> The wolf lay down. <break time="0.8s" /> Under a tree. <break time="0.8s" /> And fell asleep.

The wolf came back for the third time. <break time="0.8s" /> Show us your paw first, the little goats said. <break time="0.8s" /> The paw was white, so they opened the door. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh no, it was the wolf. <break time="0.8s" /> They hid under the table, in the bed, and in the oven. <break time="0.8s" /> The wolf found six goats and swallowed them whole. <break time="0.8s" /> But he did not find the youngest in the big clock. <break time="0.8s" /> The wolf lay down under a tree and fell asleep.

늑대가 다시 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 세 번째로. <break time="0.8s" /> 먼저 발을 보여 주세요. <break time="0.8s" /> 아기 염소들이 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 발이 하얬다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 아기 염소들은 문을 열었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아이고 그건 늑대였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 아기 염소들은 탁자 밑에 숨었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 침대 속에도. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 화덕 안에도. <break time="0.8s" /> 늑대는 아기 염소 여섯 마리를 찾아냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 통째로 꿀꺽 삼켰다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 늑대는 막내를 찾지 못했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 커다란 시계 안에 숨은. <break time="0.8s" /> 늑대는 드러누웠다. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무 아래에. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 잠이 들었다.

Soon the mother came home. <break time="0.8s" /> The door was open. <break time="0.8s" /> Only the youngest answered. <break time="0.8s" /> I am in the clock, Mother. <break time="0.8s" /> Under the tree. <break time="0.8s" /> Something moved. <break time="0.8s" /> In the sleeping wolfs tummy. <break time="0.8s" /> Mother cut a little hole. <break time="0.8s" /> With her scissors. <break time="0.8s" /> Out jumped six little goats. <break time="0.8s" /> Safe and happy. <break time="0.8s" /> They put stones in the tummy. <break time="0.8s" /> And Mother sewed it up. <break time="0.8s" /> The heavy, thirsty wolf. <break time="0.8s" /> Fell into the well. <break time="0.8s" /> With a splash. <break time="0.8s" /> The wolf is gone. <break time="0.8s" /> The goats cried. <break time="0.8s" /> And they danced.

Soon the mother came home, The door was open. <break time="0.8s" /> Only the youngest answered, I am in the clock, Mother. <break time="0.8s" /> Under the tree, something moved in the sleeping wolfs tummy. <break time="0.8s" /> Mother cut a little hole with her scissors. <break time="0.8s" /> Out jumped six little goats, safe and happy. <break time="0.8s" /> They put stones in the tummy, and Mother sewed it up. <break time="0.8s" /> The heavy, thirsty wolf fell into the well with a splash. <break time="0.8s" /> The wolf is gone, the goats cried, and they danced.

곧 엄마가 집에 돌아왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 문이 열려 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 막내만 대답했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마, 저 시계 안에 있어요. <break time="0.8s" /> 나무 아래에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 무언가가 꿈틀거렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 잠든 늑대의 배 속에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 엄마는 작은 구멍을 냈다. <break time="0.8s" /> 가위로. <break time="0.8s" /> 아기 염소 여섯 마리가 뛰어나왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 무사히, 기쁘게. <break time="0.8s" /> 염소들은 배 속에 돌을 넣었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 엄마는 그 자리를 꿰매었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 무겁고 목마른 늑대는. <break time="0.8s" /> 우물에 빠졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 첨벙 하고. <break time="0.8s" /> 늑대가 사라졌다. <break time="0.8s" /> 염소들이 외쳤다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 춤을 추었다.
